title: Openness criterion for a descended stabilizer section
statement: Let R,H,g,ι,C,G,ρ,p,j,T,t,k,δ,x,K satisfy the finite faithful flat domain, finite etale, unique rotation and exact label stabilizer hypotheses of [lem-sbc-affine-torsor-split-label-laws]. Let F=C^K as the intersection of equalizer subalgebras, U=D(algebraMap H F (ι g)), and q:D(algebraMap H C (ι g))->U the restriction of Spec(F->C). For every f:U->Y×Spec H whose second projection is the canonical map U->Spec H and for which q followed by f and the first projection is the selected x-th split section, f is an open immersion. This is conditional on an already given f and both equations; it asserts no existence of a descended section or component.

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite Galois covers and permutation sets; stabilizer quotient argument

proof.text:
Proof: let V = D(h), B = D(ι g), and E = Y × Spec H restricted over B.
V -> B is a connected finite etale Galois cover: finiteness and surjectivity come
from finite faithful flatness, etaleness from hEt, connectedness from the domain,
and the Galois property from the unique rotation hypothesis on geometric points.
E is finite etale over B by base change of j. Pull delta back along k to split E
on V. The section equation says the given f induces the chosen label x. Under the
Galois equivalence, the map V/K -> E is the map from the transitive permutation
set G/K to the labels, sending the identity coset to x. The exact stabilizer
hypothesis hK makes this map injective: equal translated labels differ by K.
Its image is a union of orbits, hence the corresponding finite etale subcover is
open and closed. Therefore f is an open immersion into E and into Y × Spec H.
Here V/K is U because C[1/h]^K = (C^K)[1/h]: h is fixed and localization of the
domain is injective, so invariance of a fraction implies invariance of its numerator.
The base equation ensures f lies over B; the section equation fixes its label.
For G trivial this selects exactly one summand, not an arbitrary summand. For d=0
there is no x. No existence of f or of a descended section is asserted here.

theorem affine_torsor_stabilizer_section_open
    (R H : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (ι : R →+* H)
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra H C] [IsDomain C]
    [Module.Finite H C] [Module.FaithfullyFlat H C]
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (ρ : G → C →ₐ[H] C)
    (hρone : ρ 1 = AlgHom.id H C)
    (hρmul : ∀ a b, ρ (a * b) = (ρ a).comp (ρ b))
    (hne : algebraMap H C (ι g) ≠ 0)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (j : Y ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
    (hj : j ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) = p)
    [IsFinite j] [Etale j]
    (hEt : Etale (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H C))))
    (hrot : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] (a b : C →+* Ω),
      a.comp (algebraMap H C) = b.comp (algebraMap H C) →
      a (algebraMap H C (ι g)) ≠ 0 →
      ∃! ζ : G, a.comp (ρ ζ).toRingHom = b)
    (d : ℕ)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec R)
    (k : Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ⟶ T)
    (hk : k ≫ t = Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H C)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))
    (δ : pullback p t ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ T)
    (hδ : δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 T) = pullback.snd p t)
    (x : Fin d) (K : Subgroup G)
    (hK : ∀ ζ, ζ ∈ K ↔
      fixedPunctureDescentAction R H g ι C G ρ hρone hρmul hne
        p T t k hk d δ hδ ζ x = x) :
    let F := (⨅ ζ : K, AlgHom.equalizer (ρ ζ.val) (AlgHom.id H C) : Subalgebra H C)
    let U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of F)).Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H F (ι g))
    let q := (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom F.val.toRingHom)).resLE
      U (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) (by
        change PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g)) ≤
          PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))
        rfl)
    ∀ (f : Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of F)) U ⟶
        pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))),
      f ≫ pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) =
        Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of F)) U ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H F)) →
      q ≫ f ≫ pullback.fst p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) =
        fixedSplitSection p t k d δ x →
      IsOpenImmersion f
